item.dc:creator: María Luisa Nolé Juan Luis Higuera-Trujillo Carmen Llinares a Facultad de Ciencias de la Salud, Universidad Internacional de Valencia, Valencia, Spainb Facultad de Ciencias de la Salud, Universidad Internacional de La Rioja, La Rioja, Spainc Department of Mechanical Engineering and Industrial Design, University of Cadiz, Cadiz, Spaind Instituto Universitario de Investigación en Tecnología Centrada en el Ser Humano (HUMAN-tech), Universitat Politècnica de València, Valencia, SpainMaria Luisa Nole is a psychologist and researcher with a multidisciplinary background, specializing in neuroarchitecture and the integration of psychology and neuropsychology into engineering and architecture.Juan Luis Higuera-Trujillo is a researcher who has contributed to the development of neuroarchitecture in Spain since its inception. He specializes in the application of visualization technologies, particularly virtual reality, to research in this field. He also serves as Chapter Leader for Spain within the Academy of Neuroscience for Architecture (ANFA).Carmen Llinares is a pioneering researcher who has played a leading role in the development and establishment of neuroarchitecture in Spain. Her work has been instrumental in advancing the integration of neuroscience into architectural research and design. She also serves as Chapter Leader for Spain within the Academy of Neuroscience for Architecture (ANFA).
